Bash(node -e "const fs=require\('fs'\); const files=fs.readdirSync\('.'\).filter\(f=>f.endsWith\('.json'\)\); for\(const f of files\){ const w=JSON.parse\(fs.readFileSync\(f,'utf8'\)\); const names=new Set\(w.nodes.map\(n=>n.name\)\); const broken=[]; for\(const [src,connsByOut] of Object.entries\(w.connections||{}\)\){ if\(!names.has\(src\)\) broken.push\('SRC: '+src\); for\(const conns of connsByOut.main||[]\){ for\(const c of conns||[]\){ if\(!names.has\(c.node\)\) broken.push\('TGT: '+c.node\); } } } const aiNode=w.nodes.find\(n=>/Gemini|Análisis/.test\(n.name\)\); const prompt=aiNode?.parameters?.messages?.values?.[0]?.content||''; const hasZeroHall=prompt.includes\('Zero-Hallucination'\); const hasValidez=prompt.includes\('REGLA DE VALIDEZ'\); const recruiterEmail=w.nodes.find\(n=>n.type==='n8n-nodes-base.gmail' && /RH|abelardo/i.test\(n.parameters?.sendTo||''\)\)?.parameters?.message||''; const hasRec=recruiterEmail.includes\('recomendacion_contratacion'\)&&recruiterEmail.includes\('fortalezas_operativas'\)&&recruiterEmail.includes\('riesgos_potenciales'\); console.log\(f.padEnd\(28\)+' connections:'+\(broken.length?'BROKEN '+broken.join\(','\):'OK'\)+' | prompt:'+\(hasZeroHall&&hasValidez?'OK':'FAIL'\)+' | email:'+\(hasRec?'OK':'FAIL'\)\); }")
